const f = (x: number): number => x * 2;
console.log(f.call(null, 5), f.apply(null, [6]), f.bind(null, 7)(), f.bind(null)(8));
const g = (x: number, y: string): string => `${x}${y}`;
const bound = g.bind(null, 1);
console.log(bound("a"), g.call(undefined, 2, "b"), g.apply(undefined, [3, "c"]));
class Counter {
  count = 0;
  add(step: number): number {
    this.count += step;
    return this.count;
  }
}
const counter = new Counter();
console.log(counter.add.call(counter, 2), counter.add.apply(counter, [3]), counter.add.bind(counter)(4));
function greet(this: { name: string }, greeting: string): string {
  return `${greeting}, ${this.name}`;
}
console.log(greet.call({ name: "Ann" }, "Hi"), greet.bind({ name: "Bo" })("Yo"));
class Point {
  constructor(public x: number, public y: number) {}
}
const AtOrigin = Point.bind(null, 0);
console.log(new AtOrigin(5));
const noArgs = (): string => "none";
console.log(noArgs.call(null), noArgs.apply(null));
function sum(...values: number[]): number {
  return values.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
}
console.log(sum.call(null, 1, 2, 3), sum.apply(null, [4, 5]), sum.bind(null, 1)(2, 3));
const generic = <T,>(value: T): T => value;
console.log(generic.call(null, "g"));
const anyFn: Function = f;
console.log(anyFn.call(null, 9));
